messages:
Maya R: hey folks — quick ask: need a reviewer to approve #4321 (migration guide: session-handling -> KV cache behavior). small changes, needs a docs preview check. target merge slot tomorrow 10:00 PT. who's able to pick this up?
Tom H: I'll take a look in an hour. is there a docs preview link?
Maya R: thanks! preview is at https://docs-preview.internal/4321 (expires 24h). CI shows one failing linting rule (link-check) — i fixed it but want a sanity check on the examples.
Tom H: cool. pinging @Anil S for the SDK snippet change — the go snippet had a panic fix.
Anil S: on it. will run the example locally. which branch?
Maya R: branch: docs/migrate-kv-cache. relevant diff: `examples/go/sessions.md` shows updated `client.Opts` section.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded for branch docs/migrate-kv-cache — https://ci.internal/preview/4321 :white_check_mark:
Tom H: nice. quick q: should this be merged before branch rename in platform? if merged early we may need a tiny follow-up.
Maya R: good point. platform rename scheduled after 13:00 PT tomorrow. preferred: merge before rename so the guide references old name for now. I'll coordinate with platform.
Emma C: I can do a final pass for clarity around the 'cache invalidation' paragraph. Could I request commit access to push minor wording? or should it be a new PR?
Maya R: please push minor wording as an edit — it's just a sentence swap. I left `TODO` comment where to update.
Jorge P: Heads-up: I'm on pager rotation tomorrow morning until 11:30 PT, but free after. If you need a merge slot at 10:00 PT, I can approve but won't be on-call for followups.
Anil S: local run shows the go snippet error fixed. small nits: change variable name from `c` to `client` for clarity.
Tom H: :thumbsup: I'll update the snippet and push. Maya — after update, can you re-run preview? docs-bot should pick it up automatically.
docs-bot: New preview queued for commit df3a8b on docs/migrate-kv-cache — https://ci.internal/preview/4321 (ETA ~3m)
Maya R: perfect, thanks all. plan: Tom will push snippet change in 30m, Emma will edit wording, Anil verifies examples, Jorge does merge at 10:00 PT if everything green. I'll leave a merge hold label until 09:45 PT.
Tom H: pushed snippet change (commit df3a8b).
docs-bot: Preview build passed for commit df3a8b — https://ci.internal/preview/4321 :rocket: Link-check passed.
Maya R: ok removing merge hold at 09:46 PT and assigning to @Jorge P for merge.
Jorge P: merging now. leaving a small follow-up issue to update platform rename refs later. :white_check_mark:
Tom H: thanks y'all. can we add a quick note in the migration guides index about the platform rename caveat?
Maya R: done — added note in index with links. closing thread.
